_comment: HIS-C2-LA-01 (History, Magadh): the worked example the kit was built on.
One entry per 8-second clip. The spoken line for scene N is lines.json[N].
camera: one sentence, Google's order starts with the shot.
accessory: true adds the video-wide accessory (below) to his wardrobe for that scene.
setting: where he is, as a clause following his wardrobe.
before / after: what he DOES before and after the line. Never leave these empty:
a generator handed idle seconds fills them with invented speech.
others: other people in shot, said positively; empty when he is alone.
sound: the ambient sound, one sentence.
accessory: with a cream cotton cloth over his left shoulder

1.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
1.setting: stands in front of a plain dark teal wall, softly lit from his left
1.before: He takes a breath, raises an index finger and looks into the camera
1.after: As he speaks he opens both palms, then he finishes, closes his mouth and smiles slightly
1.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.

2.camera: Medium tracking shot, the camera moving backwards ahead of him at walking pace.
2.setting: walks along a raised earth path between wide green paddy fields of the Gangetic plain at dawn
2.before: He walks towards the camera, looks up from the path
2.after: He keeps walking as he speaks, then stops and closes his mouth, looking out across the fields
2.sound: Birdsong and a soft breeze over the fields.

3.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
3.setting: crouches at the edge of the same paddy field at dawn
3.before: He picks up a handful of dark wet soil and crumbles it between his fingers, then looks up into the camera
3.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and lets the soil fall from his hand
3.sound: A soft breeze and distant birds.

4.camera: Medium shot at his eye level, the camera holding still.
4.setting: stands waist-deep in a dense field of ripe golden rice at low sun, a short hand sickle in his right hand
4.before: He gathers a handful of stalks, cuts them, straightens and lifts the cut sheaf, then looks into the camera
4.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and nods once, still holding the sheaf
4.others: Two farmers in undyed cotton cut the same row a little behind him.
4.sound: The rustle of rice stalks and the swish of sickles.

5.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
5.setting: stands at the edge of the rice field beside a loaded bullock cart, grain sacks stacked on it
5.before: He heaves one more sack up onto the cart with both hands, dusts off his palms and turns to the camera
5.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and steps aside as the cart begins to roll away towards distant tents
5.others: A farmer holds the bullocks' rope.
5.sound: The creak of the cart and the low of the bullocks.

6.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
6.setting: stands down in a shallow open ore pit of red earth, his forearms dusted red, a pick in his hands
6.before: He levers a lump of dark iron ore free with the pick, lifts it and turns it in his hand towards the camera
6.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and weighs the ore in his palm
6.others: Two diggers work the red wall of the pit behind him.
6.sound: The knock of picks on stone.

7.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
7.setting: stands inside a small village forge lit by an orange fire, beside the anvil
7.before: He works the leather bellows so the coals flare, then takes a finished iron sickle from the smith and turns to the camera
7.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and runs his thumb along the blade
7.others: The smith hammers a glowing bar on the anvil beside him.
7.sound: The ring of the hammer and the roar of the bellows.

8.camera: Medium tracking shot, the camera moving alongside at walking pace.
8.setting: walks through a misty sal forest beside a working elephant and its mahout
8.before: He walks with one hand resting on the elephant's flank, matching its slow pace, and looks across at the camera
8.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and pats the elephant's side
8.others: The mahout walks at the elephant's head.
8.sound: Heavy footfalls on leaves and forest birds.

9.camera: Low-angle medium shot, the camera holding still.
9.setting: sits up on the elephant's back behind the mahout in the misty sal forest
9.before: He ducks under a low branch as the elephant walks on, then looks down at the camera
9.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and holds on as the elephant passes the camera
9.sound: Heavy footfalls, creaking rope and forest birds.

10.camera: Medium shot from the deck, the camera moving with the boat.
10.setting: stands on the deck of a loaded wooden cargo boat on the wide Ganga at first light
10.before: He pushes a long bamboo pole down into the river and walks it along the deck, then looks up at the camera
10.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and leans into the pole again
10.others: Bales and clay jars are stacked behind him.
10.sound: Water lapping against the hull and a distant boat call.

11.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
11.setting: stands on the stone steps of a busy river landing where cargo boats are tied up
11.before: He takes a heavy clay jar passed up from the boat, hands it on to the next man, then turns to the camera
11.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and gestures along the line of boats
11.others: A chain of porters passes jars up the steps around him.
11.sound: Voices at a distance, water and footsteps.

12.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
12.setting: climbs the river landing steps towards the camera, the river and boats behind him
12.before: He climbs the last steps, stops and looks into the camera
12.after: As he names each one he counts it off on his fingers, then he finishes and closes his mouth

13.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
13.setting: stands at the top of the steps before a tall sandstone palace gate rising out of morning haze
13.before: He looks up at the gate, then turns to the camera
13.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and walks towards the gate
13.sound: A soft wind and a far-off conch.

14.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
14.setting: kneels at a scribe's low wooden desk in a pillared sandstone court
14.before: He steadies a palm leaf while the scribe cuts letters into it, then lifts the leaf and looks up at the camera
14.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and hands the leaf back to the scribe
14.sound: The scratch of a stylus and a quiet court.

15.camera: Medium shot, the camera holding still.
15.setting: stands among a group of court ministers on the steps below a carved throne
15.before: He turns from the ministers to the camera
15.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and turns back to the group
15.others: The ministers in white robes stand talking quietly around him.

16.camera: Medium tracking shot, the camera moving backwards ahead of him.
16.setting: walks out from the shadow of the palace court into open daylight
16.before: He pulls the cream cloth from his shoulder as he walks and looks into the camera
16.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and folds the cloth over his arm

17.camera: Medium shot at eye level, the camera holding still.
17.setting: stands in front of the plain dark teal wall again, softly lit from his left
17.before: He looks into the camera and raises his hand
17.after: He finishes, closes his mouth and smiles
17.sound: The only sound is his voice in a quiet room.
